caption.description: The caption of the InputCheckbox appears beneath the label in a lighter text color.

intent.description: Colors the border of the empty box. The checked box always uses the accent color.

label.description: The label of the InputCheckbox. When omitted, the box renders on its own with no label element.

stage.description: Sets the state of the checkbox. It overrides checked, so a checkbox with a stage only changes when you recompute the stage from an onChange handler. Omit it to let the checkbox manage its own state.

classes.description: Override or extend the styles applied to the component.
